question:
The most important aim of science should be to improve people's lives.
To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
The most important goal of scientific advancements should be to make individuals’ quality of life better. I wholeheartedly agree with this statement because improvements in the health sector and technology over the past few decades have made life easier for every human on earth.

Selfless advancements in healthcare have been vital to helping people deal with diseases that otherwise would have been death sentences; illnesses such as diabetes mellitus and hypertension used to cause significant morbidity and mortality in the past few of decades , however , ; however, with our current technology, we are able to manufacture drugs in a fast and a cost-effective manner. This has led to a dramatic decline in death rates related to metabolic diseases while allowing most patients to be able to live fulfilling lives. Let us take insulin, the drug of choice for diabetes mellitus type 1, for instance; it was discovered around 50 years ago by accident, and the scientist who discovered it decided to release the manufacturing recipe free of charge to big pharmaceutical companies who were able to mass produce it in order to try and cure the disease.

With the fast evolution of technology, people are living more comfortable lives than ever before; this is primarily because most developers and tech companies provide relatively cheap products that significantly enhance the quality of lives life for most individuals. AI integration into items that are found in almost every household is becoming more prevalent nowadays, mainly because most of the founders of artificial intelligence decided not to charge companies or individuals that want to utilise their products a huge sum of money. Alexa is one of many examples of this act; it was developed by Google and it is able to aid with controlling a vast range of smart household items, like curtains or lights, at no additional cost.

In conclusion, advancements in scientific fields should be aimed to helping people with their lives. Evolution in healthcare services have has diminished the effects of diseases on the quality of lives of affected individuals. Furthermore, progression in technologies, particularly in the artificial intelligence field, is of immense help to the average individual at a meagre cost.
